title: Publish the common-format P0 roadmap suite
instruction: Prepare and publish provisional, bilingual, evidence-backed P0 roadmaps for compute, memory, interconnect, performance portability, scientific workloads, and the HPCI reference blueprint. Use quarterly precision only when a primary source supports it; preserve unknown timing as Coverage Gaps; expose cross-roadmap dependencies and HPCI implications; publish no NDA or private information; and label the suite as Consensus-incomplete until independent models approve it.
